title: Pet Dog
text: “I was just thinking—maybe we should turn the way those folks cook into a show?”
“Woooon! Ha ha ha!”
Here are Rabbit Man, Wolf, and Crocodile Man, watching them cook. Wolf’s already drooling over the food.
“It’s already drawing plenty of crowds at the food stalls before the show even starts. The Shield Hero has decided that including this wouldn’t add anything interesting.”
“I guess so. Oh, here comes today’s highlight!”

Panda’s foster father leaps into the air, deftly slicing ingredients into small pieces with a knife held between several fingers, flinging them about, and then arranging them beautifully on the plate.
“Ah, yeah, yeah.”
Panda is assisting him, isn’t he?
“Take care of this side, too!”
Father joins in, flinging ingredients onto the plate as well… and before long, an Elephant has been assembled right on the plate.
“Ooh…”
“All done!”
Thud! It was placed right in front of everyone.
“Wow—it’s Elmelo!”
“That’s amazing!”
“How do they manage to create such intricate dishes just by flinging ingredients around…?”
That’s my Father and his friends for you. It just goes to show they can easily pull off stunts straight out of a cooking manga.
“I’ve named it ‘Braided Elmelo’!”
“It’s just decoration, but they really went all out, didn’t they?”
When you pick it up lightly with chopsticks, the shape does fall apart, but mixed in among the pieces are ingredients cut into the shape of an Elephant, which is a feast for the eyes.
“The flavor is exceptional. I won’t complain.”
“That slightly spicy kick strangely stimulates the appetite, doesn’t it?”
“It’s the kind of flavor that really soaks into a body tired from work…”

And so on—everyone is eating to their heart’s content. Of course, the Filolial-sama who participated in the circus were also devouring it with gusto. It’s an exquisite dish. This is how everyone’s morale keeps rising.
That was right after the meal, shortly after the Pandas were officially incorporated into the circus.
“Hey there, The Love Hunter <TIME Drive>—”
Kuro-chan arrived, carrying Ren—who was in his Inult form—on his back, accompanied by Ren’s companions.
“Ah, Kuro-chan, you’re back. Did you find Ren?”

Lately, Kuro-chan had been going out and complaining that Ren wasn’t there. It seemed Ren’s friends were also making a fuss about Lord Ren suddenly vanishing. However, since Ren sometimes goes missing, they didn’t seem too worried.
“Oh? Kuro-chan, who’s that on your back? Um… Keel-kun? The color scheme seems a little off, though.”
“Who’s that?! No! It’s me!”
“Well… I’m not sure.”
“It’s me! It’s Ren Amaki. I may look like this now, but I’m Ren Amaki, the Sword Hero!”
“Huh!? You… are Ren?”
My father looks over at Kuro-chan.
“Yeah. Apparently so. He smells like a Dark Swordsman, though.”
“How on earth did you end up looking like that…? Actually, you look a lot like Keel-kun.”
It’s true—Ren’s current form does look a lot like Keel in his dog form. Luna-chan seems to be in a good mood, too. Father glanced briefly at me before turning his gaze toward Ren’s companions.
“Lord Ren suddenly went missing, and a few days later, he returned looking like this.”
“R-really?　How on earth did that happen?”

“I don’t know. I was leveling up at the hunting grounds when I was suddenly attacked from behind by something and lost consciousness… When I came to, I was inside a wooden crate, and when I got out, I was in this form and found myself in Zeltoble.”
It seems Ren definitely regained consciousness in Zeltoble. But what’s with coming back out of the blue like this? He’s practically running the dark culinary world in Zeltoble, after all.
“Um…”
“I know you’re not sure how to react. I don’t understand it myself!”
Looking flustered, Ren is explaining the situation to his Father.
“Zeltoble—wasn’t that the country of merchants and mercenaries?”
Although he’s been there several times before, his Father asked just to be sure.
“Ah, yes. I had planned to go there, but…”
“So… what about that appearance?”
“I don’t know. It was listed as ‘Inult’ under status effects, and I ended up shrinking this much.”
Well, his size has definitely shrunk drastically. However, his combat power remains almost unchanged.
“What about game knowledge? Is there an event like that?”
“There’s no way I’d know about something like this! Anyway, I used the Teleportation Sword to return to Melromarc to meet up with my party!”
“Ah… I guess that makes sense in that situation. It’s not the kind of situation you can handle on your own.”
“Looks like you’ll be stuck wandering the streets, at a loss, for a day or so.”
“S-shut up!”
“Ugh… The Shadow Saint has turned into a pet dog—a ‘Pure Dog’.”
“Who’s a pet dog?!”
Ren chimed in with a retort to Kuro-chan’s lament.

“Is this… like that? I’m Ren Amaki, one of the Four Holy Sword Heroes who saves the world. Today, as I was once again absorbed in hunting monsters on my own, I didn’t notice someone approaching me from behind. I lost consciousness from their attack, and when I came to… I’d turned into a puppy! Something like that?”
“What kind of act is that?! Naofumi… you…”
What a wonderful explanation from my Father. Is Ren going to tell his adventure story like that from now on?
“No, it’s just… it seemed like it would wrap up that way. It’s amazing that his companions understood him so well. It’s hard to believe something like this, isn’t it?”
Father turns his attention toward Ren’s companions.
“He came to us, and even though he’d turned into this form, he said he was Lord Ren.”
“You believed him?”

“Not only did this child find him first and identify him as Lord Ren, but he was also able to explain everything about everyone clearly… and, well, we could see glimpses of Lord Ren’s true nature in every little detail of his demeanor.”
It seems Kuro-chan identified Ren by his scent. But Kuro-chan looks sad. Oh… indeed, that appearance must be heartbreaking for Kuro-chan. Father cast a lukewarm gaze at Ren.
“What? Stop looking at me like that! That’s exactly why I didn’t want to discuss this.”
“Even so, we can’t just leave things as they are. I thought it might not just be Lord Ren, so I decided to explain the situation to all four of the Holy Heroes.”
“I see… Thanks for coming to report this. We’re safe for now, aren’t we? Right, Motoyasu-kun?”
“Of course. There’s no way we’d end up like that.”

After all, I’m the one who did it. At least, I have no plans to perform the ritual on my Father for the time being. But if he wishes it, I’ll consider it. For example, if I performed it on him first, the loop would undoubtedly take a different turn from what it has been so far.
“Ugh… Why am I the only one who ended up looking like this?!”
Ren is clenching his fist in frustration.
“Don’t you have any idea why, Motoyasu-kun?”

Of course I do. After all, I’m the one who did it. I’m preventing the creation of a second Rival. Above all, if I let him go dragon hunting half-heartedly and he ends up earning the resentment of his Assistant, only to get beaten to a pulp on Cal Mira Island, it’ll be a real hassle to convince him otherwise.
“Even for Ren, this is a pretty outrageous situation, isn’t it? Did you talk to Itsuki about this?”
“Yeah, I actually ran into Itsuki’s group on the way here.”
Oh? So Ren reached out to Itsuki as well.
“But considering that, why aren’t Itsuki and his group here?”

“I was suddenly attacked by someone and ended up looking like this. When I told them that something similar might have happened to Itsuki, they went, ‘There’s no way our Lord Itsuki would be in such a bizarre state! What are you lot thinking, believing that Beastman who’s pretending to be a hero? We’ll put him in his place!’ and they were about to pounce on me right then and there.”
“Whoa…”

Huh? That’s strange, isn’t it? I put Itsuki under the same effect as Riska, but did he snap right back to normal right there on the spot? No, that can’t be right. It’s not something that can be undone so easily.
“They didn’t seem willing to take me seriously. So I came to you guys instead.”
